featured_reviews.review_text:
We had done a baby shower event on 30th Oct where we hired Sushant for the photography work.

Sushant seemed very polite and even during the event we were happy with his approach. On the day of the event, everything was perfect. Sushant was on time and took a lot of photos.

We started noticing glitches in the sample. The link that he shared was not optimised for the mobile phones.

Then the blunder started , all the photos he clicked didn't have proper settings.Even in natural setting the photos were too dark.

Some of the photos were corrupt, as he couldn't open in his camera. We came to know about it when we asked for the photos.

He ruined all our photos, and was blaming us for the camera settings. The worst part was the customer service, we called him multiple times to edit the photos and share it with us. He was always busy and didnt bother even to call back once.

After sales service is pathetic. The worst part is our precious moments are spoilt. They cannot correct these mistakes. The impact is more than a mere transaction.

The least they could have done is own up their mistake and give us a call back.

I would not recommend them for any photography work as they don't care about people emotions.

Agar aap chahte ho that your precious memories are captured like a dream and the whole process is stress-free, then Foto Spot Studio is the one! Highly, highly recommend! 🙌

featured_reviews.name: Nandini Arya
featured_reviews.review_text:
We hired an amazing team to capture the memories of our wedding, and we couldn't be more thrilled with the results! From start to finish, they were professional, attentive, and truly understood our vision. The photos and videos are absolutely stunning, perfectly capturing the joy, emotion, and special moments of our day. We were so impressed by how seamlessly they worked with our guests and how they managed to capture so many beautiful moments without us even noticing they were there. The final product exceeded our expectations in every way. Highly recommend this talented team to anyone looking to preserve their special memories! #fotospotstudio

Best wishes
Suraj & Nandini

featured_reviews.name: sumit patel
featured_reviews.review_text: Fraud & Pathetic service by Atesh. I had approached Atesh for my wedding Sangeet & Haldi, initially he used to call & buzz me to book him. But when I booked him, it was my WORST decision ever. At the time of event, he didn't come, instead he gave contract to some 2nd person, who booked a 3rd person, a college student to photoshoot & videograph my haldi & sangeet ceremony. During the event, I had to ask the photographer to click pictures as he wasn't doing his job & was roaming outside. I was sure that this 3rd person isn't doing his job & I raised this to Atesh. But he wasn't bothered about it as he has already got his advance payment. Finally when the time came to share all the pics & videos, I had to chase Atesh for more than a month & on top, Atesh started talking rudely on me instead of agreeing on his fault & delay. Lastly, the 2nd person who got the contract from Atesh had to call me bcz he didn't not get any payment from Atesh & Atesh was not receiving his calls too. So,I had to make entire payment to this 2nd person also, in order to get my pics & videos. When I saw the pics & videos, it was PATHETIC. There were NO videos at all, only 30-50 second clips that too from a corner. Not even a single photo captured with proper angle, lights etc. ATESH RUINED MY HALDI & SANGEET CEREMONY. I AM THINKING TO LODGE AN FIR AGAINST HIM FOR RUINING MY LIFETIME MEMORIES WITH HIS PATHETIC FRAUD SERVICE.
